title: Vegetarian Fajita Wraps
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make vegetarian wrap filled with sautéed fajita vegetables and crunchy tofu.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Press and drain the tofu, then cut into small cubes.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet and cook the tofu until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced onion and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle the vegetarian fajita seasoning over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Warm the fajita wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the tofu and vegetable mixture onto a tortilla, followed by some shredded cheese (if using).
